notes: Launch announcement, published at the embargo time (Thu Nov 19 2026 8:00 AM ET) as the second post of a two-post day (Zach, Nov 18). Built from the final release (Google Doc 'Forsured Launch Release v3'). Quotes verbatim from the release only. The 45-55% stat is cited to IA Magazine Feb 28 2026 in its own wording ('initial COI submissions ... rejected for errors or missing information', per industry estimates). The release's Stoel Rives $350K-$2M figure is left out: on Stoel's pages it's an SDI deductible range, not the cost of an uninsured gap. The BCS hours stat is left out (names a competitor outside a Buyer's guide). Real-case cost example (Zach chose Nov 18): Chuck Hamilton Construction, Ark. Ct. App. Mar 11 2026, $750K settlement, total >$1.2M, per Insurance Business Mar 13 2026.
